title: App Studio 改版（3-3）：显示名改为「应用搭建 / App Studio」——应用标签与多语言文案（只改界面显示）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: the maintainer's naming ruling on topic #37424: no 本体 / Ontology rename; the Chinese UI shows 应用搭建, the English UI App Studio (`docs/adr/0084` `#amendment-2026-11-26-position`). The maintainer asked on 2026-11-26 at 13:25Z to move phase 3 forward, and ruled at 13:26Z that the rename is display-only (「改个名字为什么还要改技能文档」). Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 3).
Grade: area:ux · Task · p2 · evidence: the product label today is "Studio" (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/studio.app.ts:32`).
Reader: area `ux-37424`.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：Studio 的显示名在中文界面是「应用搭建」，英文界面是「App Studio」。应用切换器、左上角标志和页面标题都统一。
- 只改界面显示：地址 `/studio`、代码里的名字都不动；技能文档里的说法留到第五阶段收口时一起改。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- Display text only:
  - the `studio.app.ts` label and its translations in every locale pack;
  - the Studio brand in the top-left (#37456 draws it; reuse its i18n key);
  - page titles.
- ⛔ Not changed: routes, ids, package and API names (`/studio` stays), and `skills/**` (moved to phase 5, #36910).

## Acceptance

- The Chinese and English UI show the new name wherever the app is named, with screenshots.
- Translation tests and generated-docs checks are green.
